net_arr.description: USD currency with an explicit thousand or million scale; additional correct precision is allowed.

arr_impact.description: Signed USD currency with an explicit thousand or million scale; additional correct precision is allowed.

gross_margin.description: A percentage with %, percent, or percentage as the unit; additional correct precision is allowed.

headroom.description: Percentage-point headroom expressed as %, pp, or percentage points; additional correct precision is allowed.
